title: ROLECONFLICTBENCH: A BENCHMARK OF ROLE CONFLICT SCENARIOS FOR EVALUATING LLMS’ CONTEXTUAL SENSITIVITY
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark that explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of its five primary social domains. It evaluates LLM prioritization of religious roles (e.g., priest, imam, rabbi) and identifies significant biases, such as the favoring of Abrahamic religions over Dharmic ones. Furthermore, it utilizes the theory of Basic Human Values and moral reasoning frameworks to analyze how LLMs resolve complex social dilemmas.
